courses.title: Linear Algebra
courses.summary: Systems of equations, vector spaces, linear maps, determinants and eigenvalues.
courses.description: A first course in linear algebra in six units: linear systems and matrix algebra, determinants, vector spaces, linear transformations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, and orthogonality. Each lecture states the definitions and theorems precisely and works through examples.

courses.title: Graph Theory
courses.summary: Graphs and multigraphs, isomorphism, trees and spanning trees, shortest paths, Eulerian and Hamiltonian graphs, and the travelling salesman problem.
courses.description: MTS-457 Graph Theory. The course begins with the Königsberg bridge problem and the basic language of graphs and multigraphs, then studies degree, paths and distance, isomorphism, subgraphs and complements, graphic sequences, bipartite graphs, trees and spanning trees, minimum spanning trees and shortest paths, Eulerian multigraphs and the Chinese postman problem, and Hamiltonian graphs and the travelling salesman problem.
courses.textbook: Koh, Dong, Ng & Tay, Graph Theory: Undergraduate Mathematics

lectures.title: Origins of Graph Theory
lectures.summary: The Königsberg bridge problem.

lectures.title: The Complement of a Graph
lectures.summary: The friends-and-strangers problem.

lectures.title: Graphic Sequences
lectures.summary: Havel–Hakimi, Erdős–Gallai, and graph realisations.

lectures.title: Bipartite Graphs
lectures.summary: Two-colouring, odd cycles and König's theorem.

lectures.title: Trees and Their Characterisations
lectures.summary: Leaves, unique paths, e(T) = v(T) − 1, and leaf-deletion induction.

lectures.title: Spanning Trees of a Graph
lectures.summary: Fundamental cycles and cuts, edge exchange, BFS, DFS, strong orientations.

lectures.title: Counting Spanning Trees
lectures.summary: Deletion–contraction, recursive counting, and reduction rules.

lectures.title: Matrix–Tree Theorem and Cayley's Formula
lectures.summary: The Laplacian L = D − A, Kirchhoff's cofactor theorem, and Prüfer sequences.

lectures.title: Weighted Graphs I: Minimum Spanning Trees
lectures.summary: The connector problem, Kruskal's algorithm, Prim's algorithm, and why greed works.

lectures.title: Weighted Graphs II — Shortest Paths
lectures.summary: Dijkstra’s algorithm, its correctness, and the effect of negative weights.

lectures.title: Euler Circuits
lectures.summary: Eulerian multigraphs, cycle decomposition, and route-construction algorithms.

lectures.title: Characterising Eulerian Multigraphs
lectures.summary: Even degrees, cycle decompositions, circuit splicing, Toida–McKee.

lectures.title: Semi-Eulerian Multigraphs
lectures.summary: Open Euler trails, forced endpoints, and minimum trail covers.

lectures.title: Finding Euler Circuits and Trails
lectures.summary: Fleury’s bridge-avoiding walk; Hierholzer’s circuit splicing and stack method.

lectures.title: The Chinese Postman Problem I
lectures.summary: Formulation, Eulerian case, edge duplication, odd-vertex pairing.

lectures.title: The Chinese Postman Problem II
lectures.summary: Optimal pairing of odd vertices via shortest paths.

lectures.title: Spanning Cycles of a Graph
lectures.summary: Hamiltonian paths, forced edges, the Petersen graph, and Gray codes.

lectures.title: A Necessary Condition for Hamiltonian Graphs
lectures.summary: Vertex deletion, component bounds, grid graphs, and non-Hamiltonicity certificates.

lectures.title: Sufficient Conditions for Hamiltonicity
lectures.summary: Dirac, Ore, crossing-edge lemma, Bondy–Chvátal closure.

lectures.title: The Traveling Salesman Problem I
lectures.summary: Exact tours, nearest neighbour, cheapest link, performance bounds.

lectures.title: The Traveling Salesman Problem II & Synthesis
lectures.summary: Bracketing the optimum: spanning trees, Euler tours, matching and local improvement.

courses.title: 9th & 10th Mathematics: AKU-EB and Other Boards
courses.summary: Booklets and video lectures for Class 9 and 10 Mathematics, from sets, real numbers and logarithms to matrices, quadratic equations, coordinate geometry and similar figures.
courses.description: 9th & 10th Mathematics for AKU-EB and other boards. Each unit has a booklet (PDF) and a series of video lectures on YouTube, in English and, for every unit except Real Numbers, in Urdu/Hindi.

units.name: Matrices and Determinants
units.summary: Order and types of matrices, addition and multiplication, determinants, inverses, and solving equations by matrix inversion and Cramer’s rule.

units.name: Factorisation
units.summary: Algebraic identities, the factorisation types (a)–(i), the remainder and factor theorems, synthetic division and factorising cubics.

units.name: Coordinate Geometry and Loci
units.summary: Distance and midpoint formulas, gradient, parallel and perpendicular lines, equations of a line, and loci.

units.name: Set Theory
units.summary: Sets and notation, union, intersection and complement, difference, laws of sets, Venn diagrams, counting with sets, Cartesian products and binary relations.

units.name: Complex Numbers
units.summary: The imaginary unit, the Argand plane and conjugates, modulus, the four operations, properties of complex numbers, powers, and applications.

units.name: Quadratic Equations
units.summary: Standard form and roots, factorisation, completing the square, the quadratic formula and discriminant, changing the subject, reducible equations, and quadratic graphs.

units.name: Real Numbers
units.summary: Number sets, terminating and recurring decimals, irrational numbers, properties of real numbers, absolute value, radicals, laws of indices and scientific notation.

units.name: Logarithms
units.summary: Scientific notation, the definition of a logarithm, ln and antilog, the laws of logarithms, change of base, exponential equations, and logarithmic scales.

units.name: Similar Figures
units.summary: Similarity and scale factor, similar triangles (AA, SSS, SAS), similar plane figures and solids, and how lengths, areas, volumes and masses scale.

courses.title: Calculus
courses.summary: Limits, continuity, derivatives, integrals and their applications.
courses.description: Materials for the Calculus I and II sequence: limits and continuity, differentiation and its applications, the definite integral and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, techniques of integration, and sequences and series.

lectures.title: Limits and Continuity
lectures.summary: Informal and ε–δ limits, limit laws, continuity, the Intermediate Value Theorem.

lectures.title: The Derivative
lectures.summary: The derivative as a limit, differentiability implies continuity, basic rules.

lectures.title: Applications of the Derivative
lectures.summary: Extrema, the Mean Value Theorem, curve sketching.

lectures.title: The Definite Integral
lectures.summary: Riemann sums and the definite integral.

lectures.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
lectures.summary: Both parts of the FTC and their use.

lectures.title: Techniques of Integration
lectures.summary: Substitution, integration by parts, partial fractions.

courses.title: Abstract Algebra
courses.summary: Groups, subgroups, cosets, homomorphisms, rings and ideals.
courses.description: An introduction to algebraic structures. The course begins with groups (subgroups, cyclic groups, cosets and Lagrange's theorem, normal subgroups and quotients, homomorphisms) and continues to rings, ideals and quotient rings.

lectures.title: Groups: Definitions and Examples
lectures.summary: Group axioms, abelian groups, integers mod n, symmetric and dihedral groups.

lectures.title: Subgroups and Lagrange's Theorem
lectures.summary: Subgroup test, cyclic subgroups, cosets, Lagrange's theorem and corollaries.

lectures.title: Normal Subgroups and Quotient Groups
lectures.summary: Normality, quotient groups.

lectures.title: Homomorphisms and Isomorphism Theorems
lectures.summary: Kernels, the First Isomorphism Theorem.

lectures.title: Rings and Ideals
lectures.summary: Rings, integral domains, fields, ideals.

lectures.title: Quotient Rings and Ring Homomorphisms
lectures.summary: Prime and maximal ideals.
